# NASA assets (downloaded by scripts/fetch-nasa-assets.mjs)

NASA imagery and 3D models are generally not copyrighted (NASA media usage guidelines); credit NASA.

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `moon_small.glb` (13.80 MB) | https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/vis/a010000/a014900/a014959/moon_small.glb |
| `apollo-lm.glb` (0.72 MB) | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources/master/3D%20Models/Apollo%20Lunar%20Module/Apollo%20Lunar%20Module.glb |
| `terrain/apollo-11.stl` (7.14 MB) | https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/3d/resources/printable/apollo-11---landing-site/Apollo%2011%20-%20Landing%20Site.stl |
| `terrain/apollo-12.stl` (26.42 MB) | https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/3d/resources/printable/apollo-12---landing-site/Apollo%2012%20-%20Landing%20Site.stl |
| `terrain/apollo-14.stl` (6.96 MB) | https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/3d/resources/printable/apollo-14---landing-site/Apollo%2014%20-%20Landing%20Site.stl |
| `terrain/apollo-15.stl` (7.06 MB) | https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/3d/resources/printable/apollo-15---landing-site/Apollo%2015%20-%20Landing%20Site.stl |
| `terrain/apollo-16.stl` (6.94 MB) | https://assets.science.nasa.gov/content/dam/science/cds/3d/resources/printable/apollo-16---landing-site/Apollo%2016%20-%20Landing%20Site.stl |
| `moontrek/3/<row>/<col>.jpg` (128 tiles) | NASA Moon Trek WMTS, LRO WAC global mosaic: https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/Moon/EQ/LRO_WAC_Mosaic_Global_303ppd_v02/1.0.0/default/default028mm/{z}/{row}/{col}.jpg |

- moon_small.glb: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio, "Moon 3D Models for Web, AR, and Animation" (https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/14959/).
- Apollo landing sites: NASA 3D Resources (https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/), 30x30 km height maps, Z exaggerated 60x.
- Apollo Lunar Module: NASA 3D Resources on GitHub (https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources).
- three.js r158 (MIT) in ../three/.
